title.en: Policing minister makes statement on anti-migrant protests – UK politics live
title.zh: 部长谴责朴茨茅斯“恶棍式”的极右翼反移民抗议者——英国政治直播

summary.en: Minister Emma Reynolds has condemned far-right, anti-migrant protesters in Portsmouth, stating that their demonstrations 'cross a line'. The unrest in Portsmouth has led to condemnation from ministers regarding the 'thuggish' actions of the activists.
summary.zh: 大臣Emma Reynolds谴责了朴茨茅斯极右翼反移民抗议者的行为，称其示威“越过了底线”。朴茨茅斯的骚乱导致大臣们谴责了这些活动家“恶棍式”的行为。

body.en: The prime minister earlier referred to the behaviour as ‘thuggish’ Healey says Andy Burnham set out in his statement to MPs last week what he thought had gone wrong The fundamentals of our economy [were] hollowed out through a series of past policy decisions, political power was centralised, weakening the relationships between the people, the businesses and the institutions who can make things happen beyond Whitehall. The economic enablers were privatised and outsourced, leaving accountability to a thicket of arm’s length bodies and regulators, too often without the predictability or the pace that underpins a thriving market economy. And our country was deindustrialised as the cost to make anything, to build anything here soared, and our dependence on unreliable sources grew, including in areas critical to our national security and sovereignty. Let me be clear, I recognise that the costs of business, its energy bills, regulation, burdens, planning constraints, labour costs, have grown since Covid and I want to draw the line. And whether it is the cost of business or the cost of living, the only way we deal with these in the long term is growth. Continue reading...
body.zh: 艾玛·雷诺兹表示，示威活动“越界” 朴茨茅斯骚乱约翰·希利即将发表有关经济的演讲后，部长们谴责“凶残”的极右翼活动人士。以下是财政部隔夜发布的摘录。英国即将迎来转机 关于英国的新故事。一个乐观的故事。韧性之一。自豪。巨大的潜在潜力。一个正在拐弯的国家。这个国家的人民、企业和社区已准备好抓住新技术和新思想的机遇。询问经济学家什么是增长，你会得到一个数字。但问问这个国家，你会得到不同的答案。一个年轻人在一家蒸蒸日上的公司找到了一份新工作。一位个体工商户赢得了一份新合同，可以支付与孩子一起度假的费用。一家企业赢得了新的出口订单，给周围的社区带来了新的生机。”首相对过去的问题做出了明确的诊断。解决方案是一个根本性的转变，首先要把权力放在正确的地方。英国增长故事的下一篇章将在更多地方书写。我们需要一个强大的战略中心来帮助地方领导人实现他们的雄心，而不是让复杂性和繁文缛节成为障碍。这就是我们创建 No 10 North 的原因，与财政部一起履行双重使命，消除障碍，以便地方领导人和企业能够齐心协力推动增长和生产力。我希望看到这个国家创造财富。我希望看到企业盈利。为了创造条件，我们需要各级政府积极负责，消除障碍，为更多投资创造条件。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The scenes in Portsmouth, where protests are described as 'thuggish' and anti-migrant, highlight a deep societal tension. The prophet Amos cried out, 'Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!' This call for justice and proper conduct echoes today, urging us to seek a society where all are treated with dignity, not met...
reflection.zh: 朴茨茅斯发生的抗议活动被描述为“恶棍式”和反移民，这凸显了深刻的社会紧张。先知阿摩司曾呼喊：“惟愿公平如大水滚滚，公义如江河滔滔！” 对公平和正当行为的呼吁在今天依然回响，敦促我们寻求一个所有人都受到尊严对待、而非遭遇攻击的社会。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Polanski faces Green rival in his pursuit of Keir Starmer’s old seat
title.zh: 波兰斯基在追逐基尔·斯塔默旧席位时面临绿党对手

summary.en: Hamza Chowdhury states that most of his fellow Green Camden councillors support him to contest the 8 October byelection. Zack Polanski is facing unexpected opposition from within his own party in his bid to contest the Holborn and St Pancras byelection for the Greens. A local councillor, Hamza Chowdhury, has also put...
summary.zh: 哈姆扎·乔杜里表示，他的大多数绿党坎登议员同僚都支持他竞选10月8日的议席空缺。扎克·波兰斯基在代表绿党竞选霍尔本和圣潘克拉斯议席空缺时，面临党内意想不到的反对。当地议员哈姆扎·乔杜里也已申请提名，并表示该席位不需要“一个只会出现在传单上的政客”。在基尔·斯塔默正式辞去议员职务后，议席空缺的补选日期已确定为10月8日。

body.en: Hamza Chowdhury says most of his fellow Green Camden councillors back him to contest 8 October byelection UK politics live – latest updates Zack Polanski is facing unexpected opposition from his own party in his attempt to fight the Holborn and St Pancras byelection for the Greens, with a local councillor saying he is also seeking the nomination, and that the seat does not need “a politician you’ll only see on a leaflet”. The intervention by Hamza Chowdhury, a Green representative on Camden council in north London, came as the date for the byelection was confirmed for 8 October, after Keir Starmer’s formal resignation as an MP. Continue reading...
body.zh: 哈姆扎·乔杜里 (Hamza Chowdhury) 表示，他的大多数绿党卡姆登议员同僚都支持他参加 10 月 8 日的英国政坛补选——最新动态 扎克·波兰斯基 (Zack Polanski) 在试图为绿党争取霍尔本和圣潘克拉斯补选中时，面临着来自本党的意外反对，一位当地议员表示，他也在寻求提名，而且该席位不需要“一个只在传单上看到的政治家”。凯尔·斯塔默 (Keir Starmer) 正式辞去议员职务后，补选日期确定为 10 月 8 日，伦敦北部卡姆登议会的绿党代表哈姆扎·乔杜里 (Hamza Chowdhury) 进行了干预。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Zack Polanski seeks to represent the Greens in the Holborn and St Pancras byelection, he faces an internal challenge from fellow councillor Hamza Chowdhury. This contest within the party raises questions about the qualities and motivations of those who seek public office. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true service is not about personal ambition, but about...
reflection.zh: 当扎克·波兰斯基寻求代表绿党竞选霍尔本和圣潘克拉斯的议席空缺时，他面临着同党议员哈姆扎·乔杜里的内部挑战。这场党内竞争引发了对寻求公职者素质和动机的疑问。弥迦书6:8提醒我们，真正的服务不在于个人野心，而在于秉持公义，喜爱怜悯，并谦卑地与雅伟同行。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Syrian reactor could have been used for nuclear weapons if completed, UN says
title.zh: 联合国称叙利亚反应堆若建成或可用于制造核武器

summary.en: The head of the UN nuclear watchdog stated that a secret nuclear reactor built during the Assad era in Syria, if completed, would have been capable of producing fissile material for potential use in nuclear weapons.
summary.zh: 联合国核监督机构负责人表示，叙利亚在阿萨德统治时期秘密建造的一座几乎完工的核反应堆，若建成将有能力生产可用于制造核武器的裂变材料。

body.en: Chief of nuclear watchdog says secret Assad-era facility would have been able to produce fissile material A nearly complete nuclear reactor built secretly during the rule of the toppled Syrian leader Bashar al-Assad would have been able to produce fissile material for possible use in nuclear weapons, the chief of the UN nuclear watchdog has revealed. Inspectors from the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) last month visited two sites, one in Deir ez-Zor and a second undisclosed location identified to them by Syrian authorities. Continue reading...
body.zh: 核监察机构负责人表示，阿萨德时代的秘密设施本来能够生产裂变材料 联合国核监察机构负责人透露，在被推翻的叙利亚领导人巴沙尔·阿萨德统治期间秘密建造的几乎完整的核反应堆本来能够生产可用于核武器的裂变材料。国际原子能机构（IAEA）的视察员上个月访问了两个地点，一个位于代尔祖尔，另一个是叙利亚当局向他们确定的秘密地点。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The revelation of Syria's secret nuclear reactor project underscores the persistent human drive to develop ever more destructive capabilities. Isaiah's vision of nations beating swords into plowshares offers a stark contrast to such endeavors, calling for a future where military might is transformed into instruments of peace and sustenance.
reflection.zh: 叙利亚秘密核反应堆项目的披露，凸显了人类不断发展更具毁灭性能力的持久冲动。以赛亚关于列国将刀打成犁头的异象，与此类努力形成了鲜明对比，呼唤着一个军事力量转化为和平与滋养工具的未来。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Nicaragua challenges German arms exports to Israel at ICJ
title.zh: 尼加拉瓜就德国向以色列出口武器一事在海牙国际法院提起诉讼

summary.en: Nicaragua has accused Germany of violating the Genocide Convention by supplying arms to Israel and has asked the International Court of Justice (ICJ) to take up the case. Germany has requested the ICJ dismiss the case on jurisdictional grounds, stating its arms exports are documented, published, and subject to...
summary.zh: 尼加拉瓜指控德国违反《灭绝种族公约》，向以色列供应武器，并已请求国际法院（ICJ）受理此案。德国则要求国际法院以管辖权为由驳回此案，并表示其武器出口均有记录、已公开且受到严格审查。

body.zh: 德国已请求国际法院以管辖权为由驳回此案。它还表示，其向以色列的武器出口是有记录、公开的，并且受到比大多数国家更严格的检查。 德国周一要求国际法院驳回尼加拉瓜提起的诉讼，指控柏林在加沙与哈马斯的战争中向以色列提供武器，违反了 1948 年《种族灭绝公约》。 如果国际法院（也称为世界法院）决定审理此案，整个过程可能需要数年时间，并且取决于海牙单独的加沙相关案件的调查结果。 但德国辩称，它甚至不应该走那么远，称尼加拉瓜没有遵循适当的程序，而且该争端不属于国际法院的管辖范围。 另一方面，尼加拉瓜认为应该审理此案，因为它和德国都是《种族灭绝公约》的签署国——尽管双方都没有直接参与以色列和哈马斯在加沙的战争，而且国际法院关于以色列是否在加沙实施种族灭绝行为的听证会可能需要数年时间。 尼加拉瓜指责德国向以色列出售武器，协助和教唆加沙种族灭绝，并称其中一些武器已在加沙使用。 2024 年加沙战争最激烈时，最初申请紧急禁令停止出口的努力失败了，但德国也未能尽早立即永久驳回此案。 由于冲突持续且伤亡数字上升，德国政府于 2025 年暂停向以色列出口武器约三个月。但自去年年底达成休战以来，以色列又重新启动了这些行动，该休战基本上停止了战斗，但以色列的袭击并未完全结束。 一方面，1948 年《种族灭绝公约》在很大程度上是从大屠杀的教训和二战后“不再发生”的精神中诞生的。但出于同样的原因，德国始终寻求与以色列保持密切的合作关系，以色列的国家在很大程度上是由于大规模灭绝欧洲犹太人而形成的。它认为以色列的安全是其作为现代民主国家存在的理由的一部分。 哈马斯于 2023 年 10 月 7 日对以色列发动恐怖袭击后，以色列在加沙发动了针对哈马斯的战争。 10 月 7 日是自大屠杀以来犹太人死亡人数最多的一天。哈马斯是一个总部位于加沙地带的巴勒斯坦伊斯兰组织。 德国辩称，该案应根据程序理由驳回，而尼加拉瓜关于协助和教唆种族灭绝的指控没有事实根据。 尽管德国、尼加拉瓜和以色列都...

reflection.en: The news of Nicaragua challenging Germany at the International Court of Justice over arms exports to Israel highlights the complex global dynamics of conflict and accountability. In times of war, the world often looks for divine intervention to cease hostilities and dismantle instruments of destruction. Psalm 46:9 speaks to this hope, envisioning a future...
reflection.zh: 尼加拉瓜就德国向以色列出口武器一事在国际法院提起诉讼的消息，凸显了冲突与问责在全球范围内的复杂动态。在战争时期，世界常常寻求神圣的干预来停止敌对行动并拆除毁灭的工具。《诗篇》46:9 呼应了这一希望，描绘了一个武器被废弃、和平得以实现的未来。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Tanzanian President Samia's husband dies in hospital
title.zh: 坦桑尼亚总统哈桑的丈夫在医院去世

summary.en: Hafidh Ameir Hassan, the husband of Tanzanian President Samia Suluhu Hassan, has passed away while receiving medical treatment in Zanzibar. He was an agricultural academic who maintained a low public profile and became Tanzania's first First Gentleman in 2021. He was reportedly suffering from a heart condition and was...
summary.zh: 坦桑尼亚总统萨米亚·苏卢胡·哈桑的丈夫哈菲兹·阿米尔·哈桑在桑给巴尔一家医院接受治疗期间去世。他是一位农业学者，公众形象低调，于2021年成为坦桑尼亚第一位第一先生。据报道，他患有心脏病，并于周一晚间下葬。

body.en:
The husband of Tanzania's President Samia Suluhu Hassan, Hafidh Ameir Hassan, has died while receiving treatment at a hospital in Zanzibar.

Vice-president Deogratius Ndejembi - who made the official announcement of Ameir's death - said he had been suffering from a heart condition.

He was buried at his family's residence in Kizimkazi, a village on the country's semi-autonomous island of Zanzibar, on Monday evening.

Ameir was an agricultural academic who largely kept a low public profile. He became Tanzania's first First Gentleman after President Samia took office in 2021.

In his announcement, Ndejembi said Ameir died at 08:00 local time (06:00 GMT) on Monday at the Emilio Mzena Memorial Hospital.

The vice-president led tributes as he conveyed his condolences to Samia, as well as Ameir's family and friends.

Kenyan President William Ruto said he received the news of his passing with "deep sorrow".

"President Samia has lost a lifelong companion, her children a beloved father, and Tanzania a distinguished son," he wrote on social media.

Zambia's President Hakainde Hichilema also shared his condolences, saying that they "stand side by side" with the first family, and all of Tanzania during "this difficult time".

Similarly, Burundi's President Évariste Ndayishimiye paid his respects and prayed for Samia and her family to have "comfort and strength in this difficult moment".

The First Gentleman rarely appeared in public alongside the president. He was only occasionally seen with her at official events.

He married Samia in 1978, before she entered national politics. The couple had four children - three sons and a daughter - together.

Their daughter, Wanu Hafidh Ameir, is also a politician who currently serves in Zanzibar's House of Representatives in the National Assembly.
body.zh: 坦桑尼亚总统萨米亚·苏鲁胡·哈桑的丈夫哈菲德·阿米尔·哈桑在桑给巴尔一家医院接受治疗时去世。 正式宣布阿米尔去世的副总统德奥格拉修斯·恩德杰姆比 (Deogratius Ndejembi) 表示，阿米尔一直患有心脏病。 周一晚上，他被埋葬在该国半自治桑给巴尔岛基济姆卡济村的家人住所。 阿米尔是一位农业学者，在公众面前一直保持低调。 2021年萨米亚总统就职后，他成为坦桑尼亚第一位第一绅士。 恩德杰姆比在声明中表示，阿梅尔于周一当地时间 08:00（格林尼治标准时间 06:00）在埃米利奥·姆泽纳纪念医院去世。 副总统向萨米亚以及阿米尔的家人和朋友表示哀悼。 肯尼亚总统威廉·鲁托表示，他收到他去世的消息“深感悲痛”。 他在社交媒体上写道：“萨米亚总统失去了一位终生伴侣，她的孩子们失去了一位亲爱的父亲，坦桑尼亚失去了一位杰出的儿子。” 赞比亚总统哈凯恩德·希奇莱马也表达了哀悼，并表示在“这个困难时期”，他们与第一家庭以及整个坦桑尼亚“并肩作战”。 同样，布隆迪总统埃瓦里斯特·恩达伊什米耶也表达了敬意，并祈祷萨米亚及其家人“在这个困难时刻获得安慰和力量”。 第一先生很少与总统一起出现在公共场合。他只是偶尔在官方活动中与她在一起。 1978 年，在萨米亚进入国家政坛之前，他与她结婚。这对夫妇有四个孩子——三个儿子和一个女儿。 他们的女儿瓦努·哈菲德·阿米尔 (Wanu Hafidh Ameir) 也是一名政治家，目前在桑给巴尔国民议会众议院任职。

reflection.en: The news of Hafidh Ameir Hassan's passing reminds us of the universal reality of mortality. Hebrews 9:27 speaks to this truth, stating that death is appointed for all people. In moments of loss, especially for public figures, we are called to reflect on our shared human condition and the brevity of life.
reflection.zh: 坦桑尼亚总统哈桑的丈夫哈菲兹·阿米尔·哈桑去世的消息，提醒我们死亡是全人类的共同命运。希伯来书9章27节指出了这一真理，即人人都有一死。在失去亲人的时刻，尤其是对于公众人物，我们被呼召反思我们共同的人性以及生命的短暂。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Europe’s centre fears nationalist wave after AfD victory but only has itself to blame
title.zh: 欧洲中心担心民族主义浪潮，但只能怪自己

summary.en: The victory of the Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) in Saxony-Anhalt, a party with extreme ideologies, is seen as part of a broader trend in Europe. This trend is attributed to failures in mainstream policies and the gradual acceptance of far-right ideas, leading to a significant decline in support for traditional...
summary.zh: 德国选择党（AfD）在萨克森-安哈尔特州的胜利被视为欧洲更广泛趋势的一部分，该趋势是由主流政策的失败和极右翼思想的逐渐正常化所驱动。这导致了传统中间派政党（如基民盟和社民党）的支持率大幅下降。

body.en: Saxony-Anhalt win part of wider trend driven by mainstream policy failures and gradual normalisation of far right ideas Europe live – latest updates The numbers speak for themselves: Alternative für Deutschland (AfD), a party that dabbles in Nazi imagery, distinguishes between “biological” and “passport” Germans, and is too extreme even for France’s far-right leader Marine Le Pen, nearly doubled its score in Sunday’s state election in Saxony-Anhalt to 43.8% of the vote. Meanwhile, the centre-right CDU of the chancellor, Friedrich Merz, collapsed to 17.2%, less than half its total in the same race five years ago, and the centre-left SPD – Germany’s other main party of government for the past 60-odd years – scraped 9.3%. The least that can be said is that the centre did not hold. Continue reading...
body.zh: 萨克森-安哈特州在主流政策失败和极右翼思想逐渐正常化的推动下赢得了更广泛的趋势43.8%的选票。与此同时，德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨(Friedrich Merz)领导的中右翼基民盟(CDU)的支持率跌至17.2%，不到五年前同一场竞选中总支持率的一半，而中左翼社会民主党(德国过去60多年来的另一个主要政府政党)的支持率则下降了9.3%。至少可以说，这个中心没有成立。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The electoral success of the AfD, a party with troubling ideological roots, signals a deep unease within European societies. When mainstream parties falter and extreme ideas gain traction, it points to a crisis of trust and a failure to address the concerns of citizens. Proverbs 14:34 reminds us that national well-being is tied to righteousness, urging a...
reflection.zh: 德国选择党（AfD）的选举成功，一个有着令人担忧意识形态根源的政党，标志着欧洲社会深层的不安。当主流政党失误而极端思想获得关注时，这表明信任危机和未能解决公民关切的问题。箴言14:34提醒我们，国家的福祉与公义息息相关，敦促重新审视那些加剧分裂而非促进团结的政策和价值观。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

title.en: Indonesia volcano eruption leaves 340,000 stranded as airports extend closure
title.zh: 印度尼西亚火山爆发致34万人滞留，机场延长关闭

summary.en: Anak Krakatau volcano, located about 150km from the capital Jakarta, began spewing lava and volcanic ash late on Friday, causing nearly 3,000 flights to be disrupted and leaving over 340,000 passengers stranded across Indonesia as airports extended their closures.
summary.zh: 位于雅加达以南约150公里的喀拉喀托之子火山（Anak Krakatau）于周五晚间开始喷发熔岩和火山灰，导致印度尼西亚全国近3000个航班中断，超过34万名乘客滞留，机场也因此延长了关闭时间。

body.en:
More than 340,000 passengers have been left stranded across Indonesia after a volcanic eruption disrupted nearly 3,000 flights and forced airports to suspend operations for a second day.

Anak Krakatau, located 150km (90mi) from Jakarta, began erupting late on Friday, producing lava fountains and sending volcanic ash into the capital and the Lampung province. It stayed seismically active throughout the weekend.

Jakarta's Soekarno-Hatta International airport decided not to reopen at 18:00 (11:00 GMT) as planned due to the continued presence of volcanic ash near its airspace.

Flights will instead resume at 23:59 on Monday, the airport has said in a statement.

Halim Perdanakusuma, a smaller airport that caters to civil and military flights, will also remain closed until then.

Snaking queues formed at the departure halls in Jakarta's Soekarno-Hatta International Airport on Monday as stranded passengers sought refunds and tried to get updates on when they would be able to fly.

Finna, who was supposed to fly home to Jakarta from Malang, a city in East Java, on Sunday morning, described the frezny at the airport as flights got repeatedly rescheduled.

"It was very crowded because passengers from the morning flights had piled up, while those scheduled for later departures still didn't know what would happen," the 46-year-old told BBC Indonesian.

Not wanting to deal with the uncertainty, Finna eventually spent the night on two intercity trains before arriving in Jakarta at 03:00 on Monday.

"Everyone seems to be racking their brains [figuring alternative transportation options]", said Jo Shaw, who was visiting Indonesia with members of her conservation charity Save the Rhino International.

Shaw's team had axed their plans to camp out at Java's Ujung Kulon National Park after authorities raised its alert level for the Anak Krakatau volcano.

"Being stranded in an airport hotel is a relatively minor inconvenience to be resolved in a few days hopefully," Shaw said, adding that she was more concerned about the teams working on the ground with the rhinos under such environmental conditions.

A newly wed Malaysian couple who had just spent a week in Bali said they were told that the next flight back to Kuala Lumpur wouldn't be until 11 September.

"What are we going to do here for another five days? We only prepared enough money for our honeymoon and [were supposed] to go home yesterday," Amir Hamzah told Malaysia's national news agency Bernama.

"We thought we would just sleep at the airport for a few hours and then take the morning flight home [on Monday]. We never thought we would end up being stuck here for days," the 29-year-old said.

On Monday, Indonesia's Geological Agency warned that "the probability of further eruptions in the coming periods...
body.zh: 火山喷发导致近 3,000 个航班中断，并迫使机场连续第二天暂停运营，导致超过 340,000 名乘客滞留在印度尼西亚各地。 距离雅加达 150 公里（90 英里）的阿纳克喀拉喀托火山于周五晚些时候开始喷发，产生熔岩喷泉，并将火山灰输送到首都和楠榜省。整个周末它都处于地震活跃状态。 由于空域附近持续存在火山灰，雅加达苏加诺-哈达国际机场决定不按计划于 18:00（格林威治标准时间 11:00）重新开放。 机场在一份声明中表示，航班将于周一 23:59 恢复。 Halim Perdanakusuma 是一个较小的机场，可满足民用和军用航班的需求，在此之前也将保持关闭。 周一，雅加达苏加诺-哈达国际机场的出发大厅排起了蜿蜒的队伍，滞留的乘客寻求退款，并试图了解何时可以起飞的最新消息。 芬纳本应于周日早上从东爪哇城市玛琅飞往雅加达的家中，她描述了由于航班多次重新安排而导致机场出现的混乱情况。 这位 46 岁的乘客告诉 BBC 印尼语：“机场非常拥挤，因为早班航班的乘客已经堆积如山，而那些计划稍后起飞的乘客仍然不知道会发生什么。” 由于不想应对这种不确定性，Finna 最终在两趟城际列车上过夜，然后于周一 03:00 抵达雅加达。 “每个人似乎都在绞尽脑汁（考虑替代交通选择）”，乔·肖（Jo Shaw）说，她正在与她的保护慈善机构“拯救犀牛国际”的成员一起访问印度尼西亚。 在当局提高了阿纳克喀拉喀托火山的警戒级别后，肖的团队取消了在爪哇乌戎库隆国家公园露营的计划。 肖说：“被困在机场酒店是一个相对较小的不便，希望几天内就能解决。”她补充说，她更担心在这种环境条件下在地面与犀牛一起工作的团队。 一对刚刚在巴厘岛度过一周的马来西亚新婚夫妇表示，他们被告知下一班返回吉隆坡的航班要到 9 月 11 日才会起飞。 阿米尔·哈姆扎 (Amir Hamzah) 告诉马来西亚国家通讯社马新社：“接下来的五天我们要在这里做什么？我们只为蜜月准备了足够的钱，[本来]应该在昨天回家。” “我们以为我们会在机场睡几个小时，然后（周一）搭乘早班飞机回家。我们没想到我们最终会被困在这里好几天，”这位 29 岁的年轻人说。 周一，印度尼西亚地质机构警告称，“未来一段时间内可能会进一步喷发......

reflection.en: The eruption of Anak Krakatau has created a sudden crisis, leaving hundreds of thousands stranded and disrupting daily life. In times of natural disaster, when the earth itself seems to tremble, we can find solace in the knowledge that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. This ancient truth offers comfort amidst the chaos and...
reflection.zh: 喀拉喀托之子火山的喷发造成了一场突如其来的危机，使数十万人滞留，扰乱了日常生活。在自然灾害面前，当大地似乎都在震动时，我们可以从雅伟是我们避难所和力量、是患难中随时的帮助这一事实中找到慰藉。这古老的真理在这些事件带来的混乱和不确定性中提供了安慰。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: No 10 condemns ‘thuggish’ far-right activists after Portsmouth unrest
title.zh: 部长们谴责朴茨茅斯骚乱后的“恶棍”极右翼活动人士

In such moments, the call to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves becomes urgent. We are reminded to lend our voice to the voiceless, ensuring that justice and compassion prevail over...

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.

title.en: Grindr to pay £26m to settle claims it allegedly shared users' HIV status
title.zh: Grindr 同意支付 2600 万英镑以了结用户 HIV 状况被泄露的指控

summary.en: Grindr has agreed to pay £26 million to settle a lawsuit alleging it shared users' personal information, including their HIV status, with third parties, in breach of UK privacy laws. The claims relate to historical data practices before 2020.
summary.zh: Grindr 已同意支付 2600 万英镑以了结一项诉讼，该诉讼指控其违反英国隐私法，与第三方共享包括用户 HIV 状况在内的个人信息。这些指控涉及 2020 年之前的历史数据处理方式。

body.en:
Grindr has agreed to pay £26m to settle a lawsuit over allegations it shared users' personal information - including their HIV status - with third parties.

The world's largest LGBTQ+ dating app was sued in the High Court in 2024 over claims it misused people's personal information.

The class action suit was later served in the US, with the law firm leading the case saying it had signed up more than 11,000 claimants.

According to a US regulatory filing, Grindr will make two £13m payments to settle the claims. The firm said the settlement includes no admission of liability.

Grindr stressed the claims relate to "historical data practices" before 2020 when it was owned by Chinese firm Kunlun.

The filing submitted to the US Securities and Exchange Commission , external by Grindr said a settlement had been reached on 2 September.

"While Grindr disputes the allegations, it recognizes and acknowledges the distress and loss of trust expressed by some of its UK users regarding that pre-2020 period," the company said in its filing.

The firm has agreed to pay £13m to the counterparties by 31 December and a further £13m by 31 March 2027.

The claims brought more than two years ago by law firm Austen Hayes alleged Grindr had shared sensitive data with third parties for commercial purposes, breaching UK privacy laws.

It said this included information about the ethnicity and sexual orientation of its users.

People on Grindr have the option to share their HIV status along with when they were last tested - a move it says aims to reduce stigma, facilitate conversations and help users make informed health choices.

Chaya Hanoomanjee, the lawyer who led the claim, said in April 2024 claimants had "experienced significant distress" over their sensitive and private information being shared without their consent.

She said the company "owes it to the LGBTQ+ community it serves to compensate those whose data has been compromised".

Two data analytics services, Apptimize and Localytics, were identified as third parties with access to the sensitive data.

The claim said a potentially unlimited number of third parties used it to customise advertisements to Grindr's users.

It followed revelations in 2018 that Grindr had been sharing personal data, including the HIV status of its users, with the two data analytics providers.

Grindr defended the practice at the time as in line with industry standards – but it said it then stopped sharing HIV data with those companies.

It was fined £5.5m by Norway's data protection watchdog and, later in 2022, reprimanded by the UK Information Commissioner's Office for its data practices.

The company said in its filing on Friday that since 2020, it had "overhauled" its privacy practices to help meet the "unique needs of its...
body.zh: Grindr 已同意支付 2600 万英镑，以了结一项针对其与第三方共享用户个人信息（包括其艾滋病毒状况）的诉讼。 全球最大的 LGBTQ+ 约会应用程序于 2024 年在高等法院被起诉，指控其滥用人们的个人信息。 该集体诉讼后来在美国送达，牵头该案的律​​师事务所表示，已与 11,000 多名索赔人签署了协议。 根据美国监管机构提交的文件，Grindr 将支付两笔 1300 万英镑的款项来和解索赔。该公司表示，和解协议不包括承认责任。 Grindr 强调，这些说法与 2020 年之前的“历史数据实践”有关，当时它属于中国公司昆仑万维。 Grindr 向美国证券交易委员会提交的外部文件称，已于 9 月 2 日达成和解。 该公司在文件中表示：“虽然 Grindr 对这些指控提出异议，但它承认并承认一些英国用户对 2020 年之前的这段时期所表达的痛苦和失去信任。” 该公司已同意在 12 月 31 日之前向交易对手支付 1300 万英镑，并在 2027 年 3 月 31 日之前再支付 1300 万英镑。 两年多前，Austen Hayes 律师事务所提出指控，称 Grindr 出于商业目的与第三方共享敏感数据，违反了英国隐私法。 该公司表示，这包括有关其用户的种族和性取向的信息。 Grindr 上的人们可以选择分享他们的艾滋病毒状况以及最后一次检测的时间——据称此举旨在减少耻辱、促进对话并帮助用户做出明智的健康选择。 主导索赔的律师查亚·哈努曼吉 (Chaya Hanoomanjee) 于 2024 年 4 月表示，索赔人因未经本人同意而分享敏感和私人信息而“经历了巨大的痛苦”。 她表示，该公司“有义务向其所服务的 LGBTQ+ 社区提供补偿，以补偿那些数据遭到泄露的人”。 两个数据分析服务 Apptimize 和 Localytics 被确定为有权访问敏感数据的第三方。 声明称，可能有无限数量的第三方使用它为 Grindr 用户定制广告。 2018 年，有消息称 Grindr 一直与这两家数据分析提供商共享个人数据，包括用户的艾滋病毒状况。 Grindr 当时为这种做法进行了辩护，称其符合行业标准，但它表示随后停止与这些公司共享艾滋病毒数据。 该公司被挪威数据保护监管机构罚款 550 万英镑，并于 2022 年晚些时候因其数据做法受到英国信息专员办公室的谴责。 该公司在周五提交的文件中表示，自 2020 年以来，它“彻底改革”了其隐私做法，以帮助满足“其……的独特需求”。

reflection.en: This settlement underscores the profound responsibility companies have to protect sensitive user data. The alleged sharing of HIV status, a deeply personal health detail, raises questions about ethical stewardship and the trust users place in digital platforms. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God, principles that...
reflection.zh: 这项和解协议凸显了公司在保护敏感用户数据方面所承担的重大责任。据称泄露的 HIV 状况信息，这是一项极其私密的健康细节，引发了关于道德管理以及用户对数字平台信任的问题。《弥迦书》6:8 呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与我们的雅伟同行，这些原则应当指导组织如何处理个人信息。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: War criminal Ratko Mladic buried with military honors in Belgrade, Serbia
title.zh: 战犯拉特科·姆拉迪奇在贝尔格莱德获军事荣誉下葬

summary.en: Ratko Mladic, the former Bosnian Serb commander convicted of genocide in Srebrenica, has been buried in Belgrade. The funeral, broadcast live on TV, took place shortly before President Vucic was expected to call an election, and was attended by thousands of mourners.
summary.zh: 曾因斯雷布雷尼察种族灭绝罪被定罪的前波斯尼亚塞族指挥官拉特科·姆拉迪奇已在贝尔格莱德下葬。葬礼通过电视直播，在武契奇总统预计将宣布大选前不久举行，有数千名悼念者参加。

body.en:
Ratko Mladic, the former Bosnian Serb commander convicted of genocide in Srebrenica, has been buried in Belgrade. The funeral, broadcast live on TV, comes just days before President Vucic is expected to call an election.

Several thousand people lined the streets of Belgrade on Monday to follow the funeral service and burial of former Bosnian Serb army commander Ratko Mladic .

Earlier in the day, Serbian Patriarch Porfirije personally officiated at the funeral service for the former general,  who died while serving a life sentence in The Hague for genocide in Srebrenica and other war crimes committed during the violent breakup of Yugoslavia in the 1990s.

In accordance with his wishes, Mladic was laid to rest at Topcider Cemetery beside his daughter, who died by suicide in 1994.

Informer TV, a staunchly pro-government broadcaster, carried live coverage of what it described as a "magnificent farewell," without mentioning the roughly 8,000 Bosniak civilians and prisoners massacred by Mladic's Bosnian Serb forces in Srebrenica in July 1995 .

President Aleksandar Vucic did not attend the funeral, citing a previously scheduled visit by his counterpart from Uzbekistan.

Observers say that the president has tried to chart a middle course on the issue of Mladic's funeral.

Mladic was not buried with state honors, but with military honors, with Vucic insisting that the state was merely respecting the wishes of the family and ensuring a dignified burial.

"Were we supposed to forbid people from attending, forbid the funeral itself and create dog cemeteries?" he said in response to criticism from the EU .

The phrase "dog cemeteries" refers in Serbia to the unmarked graves of so-called "enemies of the people" who were executed by Yugoslav partisans during and immediately after World War II.

Vucic was equally dismissive of the decision by EU Enlargement Commissioner Marta Kos to cancel a planned visit to Belgrade , calling her reaction "stupid." He has brushed aside other criticism of the public glorification of Mladic in much the same way.

An EU spokesman said in a statement that "Any glorification of war criminals, genocide denial and revisionism contradict the most fundamental European values and have no place in the EU or in EU candidate countries."

For Vucic, who has long sought to balance Serbia between the European Union and Russia, the situation is politically delicate.

He is expected to call a snap parliamentary election as early as this week. The poll is likely to take place on October 25.

For the first time in years, there is a credible possibility that his ruling bloc could be defeated by the student movement , which has led anti-government protests in Serbia for nearly two years now.

body.zh: 被判在斯雷布雷尼察犯有种族灭绝罪的前波斯尼亚塞族指挥官拉特科·姆拉迪奇已被埋葬在贝尔格莱德。葬礼在电视上现场直播，就在武契奇总统预计将举行选举的几天前举行。 周一，数千人聚集在贝尔格莱德街头，参加前波斯尼亚塞族军队指挥官拉特科·姆拉迪奇的葬礼和埋葬仪式。 当天早些时候，塞尔维亚宗主教波尔菲里耶亲自为这位前将军主持了葬礼。这位将军因在 1990 年代南斯拉夫暴力解体期间犯下的斯雷布雷尼察种族灭绝罪和其他战争罪而被判无期徒刑，在海牙服刑时去世。 按照姆拉迪奇的遗愿，姆拉迪奇被安葬在托普西德公墓，他的女儿于1994年自杀身亡。 坚定支持政府的广播公司 Informer TV 现场报道了一场自称为“盛大告别”的活动，但没有提及 1995 年 7 月在斯雷布雷尼察姆拉迪奇的波斯尼亚塞族军队屠杀的大约 8,000 名波斯尼亚平民和囚犯。 亚历山大·武契奇总统没有出席葬礼，理由是乌兹别克斯坦总统此前计划来访。 观察人士称，总统试图在姆拉迪奇的葬礼问题上制定中间路线。 姆拉迪奇的安葬不是以国家荣誉，而是以军事荣誉，武契奇坚称国家只是尊重家人的意愿并确保安葬有尊严。 “我们是否应该禁止人们参加、禁止葬礼本身并建立狗墓地？”他是在回应欧盟的批评时如此说道。 在塞尔维亚，“狗墓地”一词指的是在第二次世界大战期间和战后不久被南斯拉夫游击队处决的所谓“人民的敌人”的无标记坟墓。 武契奇同样对欧盟扩大委员玛塔·科斯取消计划访问贝尔格莱德的决定不屑一顾，称她的反应“愚蠢”。他以同样的方式驳回了其他对公开颂扬姆拉迪奇的批评。 欧盟发言人在一份声明中表示，“任何美化战犯、否认种族灭绝和修正主义的行为都违背了最基本的欧洲价值观，在欧盟或欧盟候选国中都没有立足之地。” 对于长期以来一直寻求在欧盟和俄罗斯之间平衡塞尔维亚的武契奇来说，局势在政治上很微妙。 预计他最早将于本周召开提前议会选举。投票可能于 10 月 25 日进行。 多年来第一次，他的统治集团有可能被学生运动击败，近两年来，学生运动在塞尔维亚引发了反政府抗议活动。 武契奇预计将成为他的塞尔维亚人名单中的首位......

title.en: Burundians rush to leave Kenya ahead of crackdown on unregistered traders
title.zh: 布隆迪人赶在镇压前离开肯尼亚

summary.en: Hundreds of Burundians in Kenya are rushing to obtain travel documents to leave the country before a government crackdown on unregistered foreign traders takes effect on Monday. The Kenyan government stated that some foreigners exploited visa rules to operate small businesses without the necessary permits.
summary.zh: 在肯尼亚政府周一针对无证外国商人实施打击措施之前，数百名在肯尼亚的布隆迪人正匆忙办理旅行证件以离开该国。肯尼亚政府表示，一些外国公民利用签证规定，在没有必要许可的情况下经营小型企业。

body.en:
Hundreds of Burundians in Kenya are scrambling to process travel documents to leave the country ahead of the crackdown on unlicensed small businesses run by migrants.

Kenyan President William Ruto set Monday as the deadline for foreigners operating small-scale businesses to cease work, after the trade ministry said some exploited visa rules to work without the required permits.

Long queues were seen outside Burundi's embassy in the capital Nairobi after it said it would offer free emergency travel documents to citizens who want to go back home. Others are racing to buy bus tickets.

Kenya hosts hundreds of thousands of migrants from across East Africa seeking work and business opportunities.

Kenya's trade ministry said there had been "deliberate misuse of visa applications by some visitors", who arrived as investors or tourists but got involved in business activities that breached their declared status.

According to the United Nations refugee agency, there are around 16,000 Burundian refugees and asylum seekers in Kenya.

It is unclear how many are involved in small-scale trading or how many would be affected by the crackdown.

Burundians have been seen carrying all their belongings - from suitcases to mattresses - as they try to leave ahead of the crackdown, but some of them said they could not afford the cost of travel and urged the Kenyan government to extend the deadline.

Ruto's directive follows a similar crackdown in Tanzania last year and rising anti‑migrant sentiment in South Africa.

Burundi's Foreign Affairs Minister Edouard Bizimana said in a post on X that "Kenyans in Burundi were living peacefully but if the hate speech against Burundi continues things will certainty change".

"Kenya government is responsible for the lives of Burundians living in Kenya," he added.

His comments came after Ruto last week said that while Kenya remained open to foreign investment, it could not be "that a person comes from China or elsewhere to be a hawker or open a small shop".

He argued that investors should create jobs and expand production rather than compete with Kenyans in small businesses.

Ruto's comments sparked mixed reactions, with some critics describing them as a populist move that risked stoking xenophobia. Government officials deny the allegation.

Some foreign nationals say they fear for their safety, while police have warned Kenyans against targeting them.

Bizimana's post followed an urgent meeting he held with representatives of the East African Community (EAC), an eight-member bloc which promotes economic integration in the region.

Both Kenya and Burundi are part of the group. Kenyan representatives attended the meeting called by Bizimana in Burundi.

Bizimana said he had asked the Kenyan ambassador to convey to his government...
body.zh: 在对移民经营的无照小企业进行打击之前，数百名肯尼亚布隆迪人正在争先恐后地办理离开该国的旅行证件。 肯尼亚总统威廉·鲁托 (William Ruto) 将周一定为经营小型企业的外国人停止工作的最后期限，此前肯尼亚贸易部表示，一些人利用签证规定在没有所需许可证的情况下工作。 布隆迪驻首都内罗毕大使馆外排起长队，此前该国表示将向想要回家的公民提供免费的紧急旅行证件。其他人则竞相购买公交车票。 肯尼亚接待了来自东非各地寻求工作和商业机会的数十万移民。 肯尼亚贸易部表示，“一些游客故意滥用签证申请”，他们以投资者或游客身份抵达，但参与了违反其申报身份的商业活动。 据联合国难民机构称，肯尼亚约有16,000名布隆迪难民和寻求庇护者。 目前尚不清楚有多少人参与小规模交易，也不清楚有多少人会受到打击行动的影响。 人们看到布隆迪人带着从手提箱到床垫的所有物品试图在镇压之前离开，但其中一些人表示他们无力承担旅行费用，并敦促肯尼亚政府延长最后期限。 鲁托的指令是在去年坦桑尼亚进行类似镇压以及南非反移民情绪高涨之后发布的。 布隆迪外交部长爱德华·比齐马纳 (Edouard Bizimana) 在 X 上发帖称，“布隆迪的肯尼亚人过着和平的生活，但如果针对布隆迪的仇恨言论继续下去，情况肯定会发生变化”。 “肯尼亚政府对居住在肯尼亚的布隆迪人的生活负责，”他补充道。 鲁托上周表示，虽然肯尼亚仍然对外国投资开放，但“一个人不可能来自中国或其他地方当小贩或开小商店”。 他认为投资者应该创造就业机会并扩大生产，而不是在小企业中与肯尼亚人竞争。 鲁托的言论引发了不同的反应，一些批评者将其描述为民粹主义举动，有可能煽动仇外心理。政府官员否认这一指控。 一些外国人表示，他们担心自己的安全，而警方则警告肯尼亚人不要针对他们。 比齐马纳上任之前，他与东非共同体（EAC）的代表举行了紧急会议，东非共同体是一个促进该地区经济一体化的八个成员国。 肯尼亚和布隆迪都是该组织的成员。肯尼亚代表出席了比齐马纳在布隆迪召开的会议。 比齐马纳说，他已要求肯尼亚大使向他的政府转达……

reflection.en: As Kenyan authorities prepare to enforce new regulations on foreign traders, many Burundians are facing the difficult decision to leave their livelihoods behind. This situation underscores the precariousness faced by migrants seeking economic opportunities, reminding us of the biblical call to treat the foreigner with the same rights and dignity as a...
reflection.zh: 随着肯尼亚当局准备对外国商人执行新规定，许多布隆迪人面临着艰难的决定，要放弃他们的生计。这种情况凸显了寻求经济机会的移民所面临的不确定性，提醒我们圣经呼吁要像对待本地人一样对待外国人，给予他们同样的权利和尊严。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Pakistan: Can creating new provinces fix governance?
title.zh: 巴基斯坦：设立新省份能否解决治理问题？

summary.en: Pakistanis broadly agree that the country needs more responsive and effective government, but many question whether simply creating more provinces is the solution. A debate has reignited over whether the current four-province system can effectively govern a country of around 260 million people, with proposals ranging...
summary.zh: 巴基斯坦人普遍认为国家需要更有效和响应迅速的政府，但许多人质疑仅仅设立更多省份是否是解决方案。关于该国目前的四省制能否有效治理近2.6亿人口的争论再次兴起，提议包括设立12至15个新省份或赋予县级政府权力。

body.en:
Pakistanis broadly agree that the country needs more responsive and effective government, but many question whether simply creating more provinces is the solution.

A politically sensitive debate has reignited in Pakistan over whether its four-province system can effectively govern a country of around 260 million people.  

Ahsan Iqbal, minister for planning and development, recently called for a national political debate on administrative reform. He proposed creating 12 to 15 new provinces or setting up 160 empowered district governments to improve governance and the delivery of public services.

Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, who first raised the idea of an administrative "reset" in July, said on Saturday that any new administrative units should be created with public support.

Defense Minister Khawaja Asif, meanwhile, has called for greater decentralization and devolution of power to the grassroots.

Despite the growing calls to create new provinces, no formal decision has been taken.

Even within the ruling coalition, there is disagreement over how and when such reforms should be pursued.

There are also questions about whether creating smaller provinces improves governance, or whether devolving power directly to local governments would be more effective.

Pakistanis broadly agree that the country needs more responsive and effective government, but many question whether creating more provinces is the solution.

"Smaller provinces are not a substitute for empowered local governments. Even with smaller provinces, you will still need empowered local governments to make the system effective and improve service delivery to the people," Miftah Ismail, a former finance minister and economist, told DW.

Supporters of creating more provinces argue that Pakistan's four existing provinces — Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa , and Balochistan — have become too large and overly centralized.

Iqbal, the planning minister, has argued that the existing system has not delivered adequate improvements in health, education, and other social services.

Interior Minister Naqvi, on the other hand, has called for an administrative structure that is better suited to Pakistan's growing population.

"Without effective local governments, whether there is one province or 25, decision-making will remain centralized at the provincial level," Abid Qaiyum Suleri, executive director of the Sustainable Development Policy Institute, an Islamabad-based think tank, told DW. 

He said any proposal for new provinces or administrative units should be assessed against potential improvements in local tax collection and the costs of creating new provincial institutions, including secretariats, assemblies, and bureaucracies. 

Suleri stressed that it should also...
body.zh: 巴基斯坦人普遍认为，该国需要更有反应力和更有效的政府，但许多人质疑简单地设立更多省份是否就是解决方案。 巴基斯坦重新引发了一场政治敏感的争论，争论的焦点是其四省制能否有效治理这个拥有约2.6亿人口的国家。 规划和发展部长阿赫桑·伊克巴尔最近呼吁就行政改革进行全国政治辩论。他提议创建 12 至 15 个新省份或设立 160 个授权地区政府，以改善治理和公共服务的提供。 内政部长莫辛·纳克维 (Mohsin Naqvi) 在 7 月份首次提出行政“重置”的想法，他周六表示，任何新的行政单位的创建都应得到公众的支持。 与此同时，国防部长卡瓦贾·阿西夫呼吁加强权力下放，并将权力下放到基层。 尽管创建新省份的呼声越来越高，但尚未做出正式决定。 即使在执政联盟内部，对于如何以及何时进行此类改革也存在分歧。 还有一些问题是，创建较小的省份是否可以改善治理，或者将权力直接下放给地方政府是否会更有效。 巴基斯坦人普遍认为，该国需要更有反应力和更有效的政府，但许多人质疑设立更多省份是否是解决方案。 前财政部长兼经济学家米夫塔·伊斯梅尔（Miftah Ismail）对德国之声表示：“较小的省份并不能取代地方政府的授权。即使是规模较小的省份，你仍然需要地方政府的授权来使系统有效并改善为人民提供的服务。” 创建更多省份的支持者认为，巴基斯坦现有的四个省——旁遮普省、信德省、开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省和俾路支省——已经变得太大且过于集中。 规划部长伊克巴尔认为，现有的体系没有在卫生、教育和其他社会服务方面带来足够的改善。 另一方面，内政部长纳克维则呼吁建立一个更适合巴基斯坦不断增长的人口的行政结构。 伊斯兰堡智库可持续发展政策研究所执行主任阿比德·盖尤姆·苏莱里（Abid Qaiyum Suleri）告诉德国之声：“如果没有有效的地方政府，无论是一个省还是25个省，决策仍将集中在省一级。” 他表示，任何关于新省或行政单位的提议都应根据地方税收征收的潜在改进以及建立新省级机构（包括秘书处、议会和官僚机构）的成本进行评估。 苏莱里强调，还应该...

reflection.en: The debate in Pakistan over administrative reform highlights a deep-seated desire for better governance and public services. As leaders consider restructuring the nation, the ancient prophetic call to "execute justice and righteousness" serves as a timeless reminder of the core duties of leadership. True reform lies not just in administrative changes, but...
reflection.zh: 巴基斯坦关于行政改革的辩论凸显了对更好治理和公共服务的深切渴望。当领导人考虑国家结构调整时，古老的先知呼吁“施行公平和公义”，提醒人们领导者的核心职责。真正的改革不仅在于行政上的改变，更在于为所有公民切实地施行公义。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Threatening letters revive fears among Kashmiri Pandits
title.zh: 威胁信件重燃克什米尔印度教徒的恐惧

summary.en: A new wave of threatening letters targeting Kashmiri Pandits, Hindu government employees who returned to Muslim-majority Kashmir under a rehabilitation scheme, has reignited fears among them. The letters, which surfaced recently, included personal details like addresses and vehicle registration numbers.
summary.zh: 新一轮针对克什米尔印度教徒（Pandits）的威胁信件，让那些根据印度政府的安置计划返回穆斯林占多数的克什米尔地区的印度教政府雇员重燃恐惧。这些信件最近出现，并包含他们的地址和车辆注册号等个人信息。

body.en:
Leaked addresses and phone numbers have reignited fears among Hindu government employees who returned to Muslim-majority Kashmir under a rehabilitation scheme.

A new wave of threatening letters targeting Kashmiri Pandits has deepened fears among those who have returned to the region as civil servants under an Indian government federal rehabilitation scheme. Kashmiri Pandits are members of the Hindu minority community who fled the Muslim-majority Kashmir Valley during a militant uprising in the 1990s.

The latest letters, which surfaced in the last week of August, named several employees. The letters also included their addresses, vehicle registration numbers and phone numbers.

"Similar threat letters surfaced in early August, but the latest contains our Jammu residential address, vehicle and phone numbers, which have also been shared on social media," Anil Koul, a government employee, told DW, urging authorities to investigate the source of the leak.

The letters have been attributed to a little-known group calling itself the United Liberation Council, which security officials suspect could be a front for the Pakistan -based Islamist militant outfit Lashkar-e-Taiba.

The group reportedly first surfaced in July, when it released a poster marking the death anniversary of a former militant commander. Authorities have yet to confirm the letters' authenticity or the existence of the group behind them.

The latest letters also distinguish between Pandits who never left the Valley — and are therefore "safe" — and those recruited under New Delhi's rehabilitation program, who are accused of working for "masters" outside Kashmir.

Jammu and Kashmir National Conference (JKNC) president and former Jammu and Kashmir chief minister, Farooq Abdullah, called them a "conspiracy" aimed at delaying the restoration of statehood, which the region lost in 2019 . 

Abdullah also questioned why Hindu officers from outside the region were not facing similar threats. 

His remarks drew sharp criticism from Kashmiri Pandit groups and the ruling Hindu nationalist Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), which accused him of being insensitive to the community's fears.

Government records show 44,167 Kashmiri migrant families registered as having left since 1990 citing security concerns, of which 39,782 were Hindu.

For Pandit community representatives, however, the latest threats are part of a much longer security problem.

Sanjay Tickoo, president of the Kashmiri Pandit Struggle Committee (KPSS), said the threats should be viewed against the backdrop of targeted killings and repeated security concerns faced by Pandit government employees in the Valley. He blames security lapses and says repeated meetings with officials since a wave of killings in 2022...
body.zh: 泄露的地址和电话号码重新激起了印度教政府雇员的恐惧，他们根据康复计划返回了穆斯林占多数的克什米尔。 针对克什米尔潘伟迪的新一波威胁信加深了那些根据印度政府联邦康复计划作为公务员返回该地区的人们的恐惧。 克什米尔潘伟迪是印度教少数民族社区的成员，他们在 20 世纪 90 年代的武装起义期间逃离了穆斯林占多数的克什米尔山谷。 八月最后一周出现的最新信件提到了几名员工的名字。这些信件还包括他们的地址、车辆登记号码和电话号码。 政府雇员阿尼尔·库尔 (Anil Koul) 向德国之声表示：“类似的威胁信于 8 月初出现，但最新一封包含我们在查谟的居住地址、车辆和电话号码，这些信息也在社交媒体上被分享。”他敦促当局调查泄密源头。 这些信件被认为是一个自称“联合解放委员会”的鲜为人知的组织所为，安全官员怀疑该组织可能是巴基斯坦伊斯兰激进组织虔诚军的幌子。 据报道，该组织于 7 月首次露面，当时发布了一张纪念前激进分子指挥官逝世周年的海报。当局尚未确认这些信件的真实性或背后组织的存在。 最新的信件还区分了从未离开山谷的潘伟迪——因此是“安全的”——和那些根据新德里康复计划招募的人，后者被指控为克什米尔以外的“主人”工作。 查谟和克什米尔全国会议 (JKNC) 主席、查谟和克什米尔前首席部长法鲁克·阿卜杜拉 (Farooq Abdullah) 称其为“阴谋”，旨在推迟恢复该地区 2019 年失去的国家地位。 阿卜杜拉还质疑为什么来自该地区以外的印度教军官没有面临类似的威胁。 他的言论引起了克什米尔潘伟迪团体和执政的印度教民族主义印度人民党的尖锐批评，他们指责他对社区的恐惧麻木不仁。 政府记录显示，自 1990 年以来，有 44,167 个克什米尔移民家庭以安全问题为由登记离开，其中 39,782 个是印度教徒。 然而，对于潘伟迪社区代表来说，最新的威胁是一个更长期的安全问题的一部分。 克什米尔潘伟迪斗争委员会（KPSS）主席桑贾伊·蒂库（Sanjay Tickoo）表示，应该在定点清除和潘伟迪山谷政府雇员反复面临的安全担忧的背景下看待这些威胁。他将此归咎于安全漏洞，并表示自 2022 年发生一波杀戮事件以来，我们多次与官员会面......

reflection.en: The resurfacing of threatening letters against Kashmiri Pandits evokes deep-seated fears and a sense of vulnerability. This situation calls to mind the ancient call to actively care for the vulnerable, to 'share your food with the hungry and to bring the oppressed into your home.' reflection.zh: 针对克什米尔印度教徒的威胁信件再次出现，勾起了他们深藏的恐惧和脆弱感。这一情况让人联想到古老的呼吁：要积极关怀弱势群体，“把饥饿的人带回家，把无家可归的人接到你家里”。虽然具体情境不同，但保护和关怀那些感到受威胁之人的基本原则，仍然是至关重要的人类和属灵关切。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

title.en: Austria's headscarf ban for under-14s faces first test as new school year starts
title.zh: 奥地利禁止14岁以下儿童佩戴头巾，新学年面临首次考验

summary.en: Austria's ban on headscarves for children under 14 is set to face its first challenge as the new school year begins. The law, passed with support from the conservative Austrian People's Party and the far-right Freedom Party, has been criticized by the Islamic Religious Community in Austria as discriminatory and an...
summary.zh: 奥地利禁止14岁以下儿童佩戴头巾的法律在新学年开始之际面临首次考验。这项由保守的奥地利人民党和极右翼自由党支持通过的法律，被奥地利伊斯兰宗教团体批评为歧视性并侵犯基本权利。

body.en:
Austria's ban on headscarves for under-14s faces an initial test as schools reopen in Vienna and other ‌states, with groups including the country's main Muslim organisation denouncing it as discriminatory and legal ‌challenges likely.

Austria's centrist ruling coalition of three parties, led by the conservative Austrian People's Party, proposed the ban in schools, arguing ‌it was acting to protect girls' freedom.

The legislation was passed in parliament in December with the support of the far-right Freedom Party. Only the smallest party in parliament, the left-wing Greens, opposed it.

The group that formally represents Austria's Muslims, the Islamic ‌Religious Community in ‌Austria (IGGO), has ⁠said the move was an infringement of fundamental rights, pledging to fight it before the Constitutional Court, which rejected challenges in July because the legislation had not yet gone into force.

The court ruled in 2020 that a previous ban, which applied to under-10s in schools, was illegal because it discriminated against Muslims ⁠and the state had a duty ‌to be religiously neutral.

Asked by national broadcaster ORF if ‌the court would overturn the new ban, education minister Christoph Wiederkehr said: "You can never be completely certain".

"We in the government carried out very intensive consultations and we in the education ministry tried very hard to write a law that complies with the constitution," Wiederkehr said.

Left-wing ‌pupils' organisations have called for protests. The new school year starts on Monday in three of Austria's nine states — Vienna, the surrounding state of Lower Austria, and Burgenland, all in the east — with the rest following next week.

The legislation stipulates a school must hold discussions with any pupil defying the ban, after which a fine of ⁠between 150 and 800 euros ($A243 to $A1,290) can be imposed.

With anti-immigration sentiment running high in Austria, the government had argued the law was aimed at protecting girls from "oppression".

"It's my decision... No one can force me to wear a headscarf, and no one can force me to take it off," a 12-year-old student told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency at a protest against the ban in Vienna earlier this year.

Malika Mataeva, co-founder of the Muslim Women Network, decried "years of systematic, deeply rooted racism in Austria" at the time.

Roughly eight percent of Austria's nine million residents are Muslim, according to 2021 government statistics.

In March, Austria's education ministry sent out information to all schools on how to...

title.en: 'We have a lot of hope': Nepal holds national day of mourning as 36 Australians still missing
title.zh: “我们有很多希望”：尼泊尔为仍失踪的36名澳大利亚人举行全国哀悼日

summary.en: Nepal held a national day of mourning on Monday for victims of devastating glacial floods, as families of missing hydropower workers feared trapped in tunnels prayed rescuers might yet find them alive. The 26 August glacial and mountain collapse on the China-Nepal border killed at least 1,398 people, with more than...
summary.zh: 周一，尼泊尔为毁灭性冰川洪水的遇难者举行了全国哀悼日，被困在隧道中的失踪水电工人家庭祈祷救援人员仍能找到他们。8月26日，中国-尼泊尔边境发生的冰川和山体垮塌已造成至少1398人死亡，超过5500人失踪，其中包括约800名外国人。国旗降半旗，并计划在当天晚些时候举行烛光守夜，遵循印度教的传统哀悼仪式。数百名水电工人失踪...

body.en:
Nepal held a national day of mourning on Monday for victims of devastating glacial floods, as families of missing hydropower workers feared trapped in tunnels prayed rescuers might yet find them alive.

The 26 August glacial and mountain collapse on the China-Nepal border killed at least 1,398 people, with more than 5,500 missing, including around 800 foreigners.

Flags flew at half-mast, with candlelight vigils planned later in the day, following traditional Hindu mourning rituals on the 13th day after death.

Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three of them from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — have buoyed hopes that more could still be alive.

Nepal Army spokesman Raja Ram Basnet said on Monday that rescue efforts were continuing "with the same tempo we had on day one".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Our focus is on search and rescue at three levels — on ground, by air, and in the tunnels," he said.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong paid tribute to the victims in a Senate condolence motion on Monday, saying we "hold close those still waiting for news".

"I want to acknowledge how distressing this time is for their loved ones — and how much harder this becomes with every day that passes," Wong said.

She said nearly 50 officers had been deployed to the region to support search, rescue and recovery efforts.

"The Australian Government is doing all we can to find Australians who remain unaccounted for, to support loved ones and to assist in the disaster response."

Families of some of the missing hydropower workers who gathered in the capital Kathmandu said the government must move faster.

"We have a lot of hope," said Reena Amatya Shrestha, whose brother is among the missing.

"They say they are doing rescue. If the rescue is there, where's the result? We need the result."

Australian tunnel rescue expert Arnold Dix, who is advising Nepali teams, said the operation presented an unprecedented challenge.

"We are facing something I have never faced before," said Dix, president of the International Tunnelling and Underground Space Association, in a post on social media.

"Not one rescue, but multiple potential rescues, unfolding at the same time, in different places, each with its own dangers, uncertainties, and lives that may still be saved."

Foreign experts, including from China, India and South Korea, are aiding Nepali teams in rescue efforts.

"We are measured not only by the lives we save, but by the lives we refuse to abandon," said Dix, a key adviser during the Indian rescue of 41 men trapped for 17 days inside the collapsed Silkyara...
body.zh: 尼泊尔周一为毁灭性冰川洪水的受害者举行了全国哀悼日，失踪水电工人的家人担心被困在隧道中，祈祷救援人员能找到他们生还。 8月26日，中尼边境冰川崩塌造成至少1,398人死亡，5,500多人失踪，其中包括约800名外国人。 死者死后第 13 天，按照传统的印度教哀悼仪式，全国降半旗，并计划在当天晚些时候举行烛光守夜活动。 数百名水电工人失踪，但其中三人从隧道深处获救——周五是两名尼泊尔人，周六是一名中国男子——这让人们燃起了更多生还的希望。 尼泊尔陆军发言人拉贾·拉姆·巴斯内特周一表示，救援工作“以第一天的节奏”继续进行。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “我们的重点是三个层面的搜救——地面、空中和隧道，”他说。 周一，外交部长黄英贤在参议院哀悼动议中向遇难者表示哀悼，并表示我们“密切关注那些仍在等待消息的人”。 黄说：“我想承认，这段时间对他们所爱的人来说是多么痛苦，而且随着时间一天天过去，这种情况变得更加困难。” 她说，已向该地区部署了近 50 名警察，以支持搜索、救援和恢复工作。 “澳大利亚政府正在尽一切努力寻找下落不明的澳大利亚人，支持亲人并协助救灾。” 聚集在首都加德满都的一些失踪水电工人的家人表示，政府必须加快行动。 “我们有很大的希望，”失踪者中的弟弟雷娜·阿马蒂亚·什雷斯塔 (Reena Amatya Shrestha) 说。 “他们说他们正在救援。如果救援到位了，结果在哪里？我们需要结果。” 为尼泊尔救援队提供咨询的澳大利亚隧道救援专家阿诺德·迪克斯表示，这次行动提出了前所未有的挑战。 国际隧道和地下空间协会主席迪克斯在社交媒体上发帖称：“我们正面临着以前从未面对过的事情。” “这不是一次救援，而是多次潜在的救援，在不同的时间、不同的地点同时展开，每一次都有自己的危险、不确定性和仍然可以挽救的生命。” 来自中国、印度和韩国的外国专家正在协助尼泊尔救援队开展救援工作。 迪克斯是印度救援被困在倒塌的 Silkyara 工厂 17 天的 41 名男子的重要顾问，他说：“衡量我们的标准不仅是我们拯救的生命，还有我们拒绝放弃的生命。”

reflection.en: The devastating glacial floods in Nepal serve as a stark reminder of the fragility of our world. The Bible speaks of all creation groaning in travail, awaiting redemption. In the midst of such loss, as families mourn and hope for the missing, we are called to acknowledge this shared suffering and look towards a future where such devastation is no more.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔毁灭性的冰川洪水是世界脆弱性的一个严峻提醒。圣经说，万物都在一同劳苦，等候得赎。在如此巨大的损失面前，当家庭哀悼并为失踪者祈祷时，我们被呼召承认这份共同的苦难，并展望一个不再有如此毁灭性灾难的未来。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Indonesian airport closures extended, thousands still stranded after volcanic eruption
title.zh: 火山灰扰乱印尼交通，航班延误致数万乘客滞留

summary.en: An erupting volcano in Indonesia has caused widespread flight disruptions, including the cancellation of all flights at Jakarta's Soekarno-Hatta International Airport and other domestic airports. This has left approximately 170,000 passengers stranded.
summary.zh: 印度尼西亚一座火山喷发，导致航班大面积延误，雅加达苏加诺-哈达国际机场及其他国内机场的所有航班均被取消。此次事件估计影响了约17万名乘客，导致数万人滞留。

body.en:
Indonesia's main airport and three others postponed reopening on Monday after halting operations following a volcanic eruption that left hundreds of thousands of passengers stranded.

Mount Anak Krakatau, about 150km from Indonesia's capital, Jakarta, erupted on Saturday, spewing a fountain of lava and a plume of volcanic ash.

Eight airports halted operations over the weekend after ash was detected in their airspace, disrupting thousands of flights and leaving more than 270,000 passengers stranded, the transport ministry reported Monday.

"These figures are the cumulative operational impact since 5 September 2026 and cover flights that have been cancelled, delayed, or diverted," the ministry said in a statement.

Italian tourist Michel Miegge was on holiday with his girlfriend and due to fly home in time for work on Tuesday, but their flight was cancelled.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"We don't have any news from the airline. We don't know if we stay another day in Jakarta or find another flight," the 32-year-old said.

"I don't think it's possible now. We found a nearby hotel, but we saw that many hotels were fully booked."

Another tourist, French painter Carol Odile, said she came with a group of friends to see Komodo dragons in Flores when she was notified that her flight was cancelled.

"We are disappointed, but our group is optimistic. We hope we can go to Flores Island very soon," the 60-year-old said.

More than 240 domestic and international flights were cancelled or delayed due to volcanic ash on Monday morning alone, Jakarta's Soekarno-Hatta International Airport said, adding that nearly 30,000 passengers were affected.

The Transport Ministry has prepared six alternative airports — including airports in East Java, Central Java, and Yogyakarta — as options for aircraft that were originally scheduled to land in Jakarta.

"We are encouraging airlines to use these airports to avoid passenger congestion, both for arrivals and departures," transport minister Dudy Purwagandhi said in a statement.

Airport operators would provide free bus services for passengers who wish to fly from other airports.

Dudy said that the Indonesian government also relaxed rules for foreign passengers who may have overstayed as a result of flight cancellations.

The probability of an eruption remained high, the country's geology agency warned.

"The threat from an eruption comes from the ejection of incandescent rocks accompanied by heavy ashfall. Another potential hazard arises from lava flows if the eruption resumes and continues," agency head Lana Saria said.

In times of natural upheaval, when our plans are disrupted and our usual means of travel are rendered useless, we are reminded of our need for a steadfast refuge. The psalmist declares, 'God is our refuge and strength, a very...
reflection.zh: 安纳克喀拉喀托火山的喷发给印尼的航空旅行带来了混乱，导致数万名乘客滞留。在自然灾害频发的时刻，当我们的计划被打乱，日常的出行方式变得无效时，我们被提醒需要一个坚定的避难所。诗人宣告说：“雅伟是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是患难中随时的帮助。”

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Five killed after Amazon cargo plane barrels off runway, hits vehicles
title.zh: 亚马逊货运飞机冲出跑道撞毁车辆致五人死亡

summary.en: An Amazon cargo plane veered off the runway at Miami International Airport, resulting in five fatalities and three individuals transported to trauma centers in critical condition. The aircraft impacted vehicles upon exiting the runway, leading to a complex extrication process for victims trapped in both the vehicles...
summary.zh: 一架亚马逊货运飞机在迈阿密国际机场冲出跑道，造成五人死亡，三人被送往创伤中心，情况危急。飞机冲出跑道时撞毁了车辆，导致被困在车辆和飞机中的受害者需要复杂的救援工作。

body.en:
An Amazon cargo plane has barrelled off a runway at Miami International Airport, killing at least five people as it struck vehicles and burst into flames.

Miami-Dade County fire chief Ray Jadallah told reporters that in addition to five deaths, three people were transported to trauma centres "in critical condition" and two more were treated at a local hospital.

"The airplane did strike a couple of vehicles" which left "a couple of victims that were actually trapped in the vehicles", Jadallah said.

"A complex extrication with our technical rescue team" was needed, "including a search and rescue of the pilot and co-pilot that were trapped in this aircraft".

Jadallah did not clarify whether the pilot or co-pilot survived, and officials declined to answer questions after brief statements.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Video showed thick smoke billowing from the blue and white Boeing 767 that had arrived around 4am AEST Monday from Puerto Rico, as fire trucks raced to the scene.

In a statement, Amazon spokesperson Kelly Nantel said the tech giant will cooperate with any investigation into the incident.

"We're heartbroken to learn that five people lost their lives in today's incident at Miami International Airport. Our deepest sympathies go out to the families, loved ones, and all those affected by this devastating loss," Nantel said.

The plane operating as Prime Air Flight 7598 caught fire as a result of the "crash", fire officials said.

"A total of 60 fire apparatuses arrived, just short, just shy of 200 men and women from Miami-Dade Fire Rescue, to begin the actual search and rescue and firefighting," Jadallah said.

"The actual cause of the incident will be determined by the FAA and the NTSB," he added, referring to the Federal Aviation Administration and National Transportation Safety Board.

The NTSB said in an X post on Sunday that the B-767-300 cargo aeroplane was flying into Miami from San Juan, Puerto Rico, and it has "launched a go team to investigate Sunday's runway excursion accident".

The airport closed all runways and taxiways due to the incident and posted an update on its website that travellers should check directly with their airline before heading to the airport.

After hours of holding all flights at the international airport with numerous delays and cancelled flights for commercial airline passengers, the Miami Herald newspaper reported that two of the airport's four runways had later reopened.

body.zh: 一架亚马逊货机冲出迈阿密国际机场跑道，撞上车辆并起火，造成至少五人死亡。 迈阿密戴德县消防队长雷·贾达拉告诉记者，除了五人死亡外，三人被送往创伤中心，“情况危急”，另有两人在当地一家医院接受治疗。 贾达拉说，“飞机确实撞上了几辆车”，导致“几名受害者实际上被困在车里”。 需要“我们的技术救援队进行复杂的救援”，“包括对被困在这架飞机中的飞行员和副驾驶进行搜救”。 贾达拉没有澄清飞行员或副驾驶是否生还，官员们在简短声明后拒绝回答问题。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 视频显示，澳大利亚东部标准时间周一凌晨 4 点左右从波多黎各抵达的蓝白色波音 767 冒出滚滚浓烟，消防车迅速赶往现场。 消防官员称，这架Prime Air 7598航班的飞机因“坠机”而起火。 贾达拉说：“迈阿密戴德消防救援队总共派出了 60 辆消防车，不到 200 名消防队员，开始实际的搜救和灭火工作。” 他补充说：“事件的实际原因将由美国联邦航空局和国家运输安全委员会确定。”他指的是联邦航空管理局和国家运输安全委员会。 NTSB 周日在 X 帖子中表示，这架 B-767-300 货机正从波多黎各圣胡安飞往迈阿密，并已“组建了一个调查小组来调查周日发生的跑道偏离事故”。 由于该事件，机场关闭了所有跑道和滑行道，并在其网站上发布了更新，称旅客在前往机场之前应直接与航空公司联系。 亚马逊发表声明称，这架飞机“在试图着陆时发生了事故”。它没有说是否有人受伤或死亡。 亚马逊发言人凯利·南特尔在声明中表示：“情况瞬息万变，我们仍在收集细节。我们正在与地方当局和官员密切合作，以了解到底发生了什么。” 迈阿密警长罗西·科尔德罗-斯图茨周日告诉记者，她的警员遇到了“真正悲惨的场景”，但“公共安全没有明显受到威胁”。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The suddenness of the Amazon cargo plane crash at Miami International Airport, claiming five lives and leaving others critically injured, is a stark reminder of life's fragility. In moments of such profound loss, we are drawn to the biblical promise that Yahweh will wipe away every tear, and there will be no more death or mourning, pain, or suffering, for...
reflection.zh: 迈阿密国际机场亚马逊货运飞机坠毁的突发事件，夺走了五条生命，另有数人伤势危重，这是对生命脆弱性的严峻提醒。在如此深切的失落时刻，我们被吸引到雅伟的圣经应许：他要擦去一切眼泪，不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛，因为以前的事都过去了。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: US envoys Witkoff and Kushner hold Ukraine talks after meeting Putin
title.zh: 美代表会晤普京后与乌克兰举行会谈

summary.en: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv, seeking to revive efforts to end the war. However, the latest diplomatic push seems to have produced no breakthrough, with Moscow and Kyiv remaining divided over key issues like territorial concessions.
summary.zh: 美国特使史蒂夫·维特科夫和贾里德·库什纳在基辅与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基举行了会谈，试图重振结束战争的努力。然而，最新的外交努力似乎并未取得突破，莫斯科和基辅在领土让步等关键问题上仍存在分歧。

body.en:
US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv, seeking to revive efforts to end the war. But the latest diplomatic push seems to have produced no breakthrough.

US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held "encouraging" talks in Kyiv on Sunday during their first official visit to Ukraine , but made no breakthrough toward ending Russia’s war in Ukraine . 

Despite the renewed diplomatic push, Moscow and Kyiv remain divided over key issues, particularly territorial concessions. Kushner acknowledged the challenge, saying the US was working "behind the scenes" to create the conditions for a possible deal.

As Ukraine's airspace remains closed due to the conflict, the pair arrived in Kyiv by train from Poland, having  held talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin  in Moscow a day earlier.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy held three rounds of talks with the US envoys, the final one joined by national security advisers from the United Kingdom, France and Germany.

After meeting with Witkoff and Kushner, Zelenskyy said the talks focused on military aid, including Patriot missile systems and other weapons Ukraine will need in the coming months. He said Kyiv was seeking "serious volumes" of US support, with backing from its European partners.

"If the war drags on until winter — and that is how things currently look — we will need a 'winter package'," he said.

The Ukrainian president also expressed gratitude that representatives of European nations were in Kyiv.

Momentum by US President Donald Trump to end the four-and-a-half-year-old conflict  has stalled in recent months after talks with Putin at the Kremlin in January failed to produce a result.

Despite hopes of a breakthrough with the Russian leader on Saturday, there were no announcements after the meeting.

Putin's foreign policy adviser Yuri Ushakov described the Moscow talks as constructive, frank, and useful but didn't discuss specific outcomes.

Ushakov said the talks also focused on economic issues and potentially large Russia-US projects.

During previous talks, negotiators have struggled to bring both sides together on a range of key issues, including the future of the industrial Donbas region of eastern Ukraine.

For Ukraine, hard security guarantees from its European allies and Washington are crucial to deterring Russia ​from further aggression.

Kyrylo Budanov, Zelenskyy's chief of staff, told the New York Times last weekend that he did not expect the fighting to end before spring 2027.

The war has escalated in recent months, with Putin seeking the complete conquest of Donbas and Russian drones targeting the...
body.zh: 美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳在基辅与乌克兰总统泽连斯基举行会谈，寻求重启结束战争的努力。但最新的外交努力似乎没有取得突破。 美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳周日在基辅首次正式访问乌克兰期间举行了“令人鼓舞的”会谈，但在结束俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争方面没有取得突破。 尽管新一轮的外交努力，莫斯科和基辅在关键问题上仍然存在分歧，特别是领土让步。 库什纳承认这一挑战，并表示美国正在“幕后”努力为可能达成的协议创造条件。 由于乌克兰领空因冲突而仍然关闭，两人于一天前在莫斯科与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京举行了会谈，并乘火车从波兰抵达基辅。 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基与美国特使举行了三轮会谈，英国、法国和德国的国家安全顾问参加了最后一轮会谈。 泽伦斯基在与维特科夫和库什纳会面后表示，会谈重点是军事援助，包括爱国者导弹系统和乌克兰未来几个月所需的其他武器。他表示，基辅正在寻求“大量”美国的支持，并得到欧洲伙伴的支持。 “如果战争持续到冬天——目前的情况就是这样——我们将需要一个‘冬季方案’，”他说。 乌克兰总统还对欧洲国家代表来到基辅表示感谢。 由于一月份在克里姆林宫与普京的会谈未能取得成果，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普结束这场长达四年半的冲突的势头近几个月陷入停滞。 尽管希望周六与俄罗斯领导人取得突破，但会后没有任何公告。 普京的外交政策顾问尤里·乌沙科夫称莫斯科会谈具有建设性、坦诚和有用，但没有讨论具体结果。 乌沙科夫表示，会谈还重点讨论了经济问题和潜在的俄美大型项目。 在之前的会谈中，谈判代表一直在努力让双方就一系列关键问题达成一致，其中包括乌克兰东部工业顿巴斯地区的未来。 对于乌克兰来说，其欧洲盟友和华盛顿的硬安全保证对于阻止俄罗斯进一步侵略至关重要。 泽伦斯基的幕僚长凯里洛·布达诺夫 (Kyrylo Budanov) 上周末告诉《纽约时报》，他预计战斗不会在 2027 年春季之前结束。 近几个月来，战争不断升级，普京寻求完全征服顿巴斯，俄罗斯无人机瞄准了...

reflection.en: Diplomatic efforts to end the war in Ukraine continue, with US envoys meeting President Zelenskyy. Despite "encouraging" talks, deep divisions over territorial concessions mean no breakthrough has yet occurred. The pursuit of peace is a difficult, often frustrating path, requiring persistent effort even when immediate progress is not visible.
reflection.zh: 旨在结束乌克兰战争的外交努力仍在继续，美国特使会见了泽连斯基总统。尽管进行了“令人鼓舞”的会谈，但围绕领土让步的深刻分歧意味着尚未取得突破。追求和平是一条艰难且常令人沮丧的道路，即使没有立竿见影的进展，也需要不懈的努力。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Weather tracker: Typhoon Saudel causes mass evacuations in south-east China
title.zh: 台风“苏德罗”导致中国东南部大规模疏散

summary.en: Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to south-east China last week, causing widespread damage and forcing mass evacuations. The city of Putian recorded 416.5mm of rain in 24 hours, leading to the evacuation of almost 600,000 people in Fujian province and affecting thousands more in other provinces.
summary.zh: 上周，台风“苏德罗”给中国东南部带来了数日的倾盆大雨，造成大范围破坏并导致大规模疏散。福建省莆田市在24小时内记录到416.5毫米的降雨量，迫使福建省近60万人撤离，另有数千人受到江西等省份的影响。

body.en: Torrential rain causes widespread damage; while north-west South Africa hit by thunderstorms and central-southern US faces oppressive heat Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian and Guangdong provinces in south-east China last week. The city of Putian, in Fujian province, recorded 416.5mm of rain in a 24-hour period between Thursday and Friday, with surrounding villages recording more than 500mm in the same period. In Fujian, authorities estimate that almost 600,000 people were evacuated from high-risk, flood-prone areas. A further 128,000 people in 53 counties were also affected across Jiangxi, with emergency evacuations affecting 9,000 people. Flooding, landslips and infrastructure damage were reported widely in the region. More than 2,500 teachers and students were trapped in a school compound in the Zhejiang city of Wenzhou on Wednesday after extreme rainfall caused flash floods in low-lying areas. At least 1,260 people reportedly had to be rescued in Putian after a river embankment collapsed on Thursday, flattening 100 homes. On Saturday, a landslip in a village of Suichuan county, in Jiangxi province, killed three people and nine others remaining missing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 暴雨造成大面积破坏；南非西北部遭遇雷暴袭击，美国中南部遭遇酷热，台风“萨德尔”上周给中国东南部的浙江、江西、福建和广东省带来连日暴雨。福建省莆田市周四至周五24小时内降雨量达416.5毫米，周边村庄同期降雨量超过500毫米。在福建，当局估计近 60 万人从高风险、洪水易发地区撤离。江西53个县12.8万人受灾，紧急疏散9000人。据报道，该地区发生了洪水、山体滑坡和基础设施损坏。周三，极端降雨导致低洼地区山洪暴发，2500多名师生被困在浙江温州一所学校大院内。据报道，莆田市周四河堤崩塌，夷为平地，至少有 1,260 人需要救援。周六，江西省遂川县一个村庄发生山体滑坡，造成三人死亡，另有九人失踪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Typhoon Saudel's torrential rains and subsequent evacuations in China underscore the harsh realities of natural disasters. In times of devastation, the human spirit is tested, yet the biblical narrative offers a path through suffering. Romans 5:3-4 reminds us that hardship can produce perseverance, character, and hope, even amidst overwhelming loss.
reflection.zh: 台风“苏德罗”带来的倾盆大雨和中国随后的大规模疏散，凸显了自然灾害的严酷现实。在毁灭性的灾难面前，人类的精神受到考验，但圣经的叙事提供了一条穿越苦难的道路。罗马书5:3-4提醒我们，即使在巨大的损失中，艰难困苦也能磨炼出忍耐、品格和盼望。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。
